annotations.title: utilpeek: SEC EDGAR financial statements by period (revenue, income, balance sheet, cash flow)

description: utilpeek: Get a US company's reported financials per fiscal year or quarter from SEC EDGAR. For the registrant and filings use sec_company_lookup. Returns a US SEC registrant's reported financials by ticker or CIK, per fiscal year or quarter (up to 20): revenue, gross profit, operating and net income, EPS, assets, liabilities, equity, cash, operating cash flow, capex and shares, each with the us-gaap tag used, form, period and accession; missing metrics are null. Informational only, not investment advice. Data: SEC EDGAR (public domain), cached up to 6 hours; no SEC endorsement implied. Send exactly one of ticker or cik; bad input is a 422 and an unknown company or no US-GAAP data a 404 (neither charged); an upstream outage is a 503 (not charged). Typically 1-4 s (cached under 0.1 s). Price: USD 0.005. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/sec-financials-api.html

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, 1-10 digits, as a number or a string (leading zeros and a CIK prefix allowed, such as 320193 or 0000320193). Send ticker or cik.
cik.title: Cik

period.description: annual: fiscal years from 10-K filings; quarterly: the discrete quarters in 10-Q filings.
period.title: Period

ticker.description: Exchange ticker such as AAPL (class shares as BRK-B, BRK.B or BRK/B). Send ticker or cik.
ticker.title: Ticker

name: sec_financials

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
